name: Paraxanthine
summary: Paraxanthine (1,7-dimethylxanthine) is the major primary metabolite of caffeine in humans and has stimulant pharmacology of its own. Small placebo-controlled crossover studies have reported acute cognitive and attention signals, but the published human evidence base is tiny, short-term, and substantially connected to commercial development. This profile remains research-only and should not imply that paraxanthine is superior to caffeine.
description: Canonical paraxanthine research entity for evidence and safety integration. Publication remains held until independent replication, direct caffeine-comparator evidence, pharmacokinetic context, adverse-effect data, and longer-duration human studies have been reviewed.
primary_effects_or_targets: methylxanthine stimulant pharmacology; adenosine-receptor antagonism; attention and cognitive-performance research
